name: imma8816_2tile
desc: IMMA.8816 int8->int32 MULTI-TILE GEMM (one warp computes 16x16x32 = 4 m8n8k16 atoms over 2x2 output tiles x 2 K-steps). The multi-tile companion to imma8816: off-diagonal output tiles expose any C/D m<->n fragment transpose that a single 8x8 atom hides (cf. the DMMA.8x8x4 square-tile transpose hazard). Compared to a host integer-GEMM oracle (exact).
